b: The more options you pursue, the thinner you become.
You can’t pursue everything and accomplish anything.
Stop chasing everything that looks good. Choose something that matters to you.
What am I pursuing because others expect it?
What opportunities reduce my contribution to what matters?
What good opportunity will I stop this week?
Don’t confuse attractive with important. Popular and meaningful often live in different worlds.
Protect the power of yes. Say no.
Goals justify effort. Eventually, effort justifies goals.
We begin because something matters. It matters more because we pour energy into it.
What worthy goal deserves my energy?
What sacrifices am I willing to make?
What commitment would make decisions easier?
Don’t wait until you feel passionate. Choose something worthwhile and give yourself to it. Passion finds you when you sweat.
Cancel a good thing. Give your best to a great thing.
The uncommitted are prisoners of possibility.
You don’t find meaning by keeping your options open. You build meaning by committing to what matters.
Choose what deserves your devotion. Slam the other doors.
What attractive opportunity do you need to reject to pursue something meaningful?
